get.description: Public references use primary or secondary IMEI only. Lifetime device history remains readable after registration release, transfer, or certificate revocation. Certificate UUIDs and short numbers are not accepted or returned. No issued snapshot returns 404; GET /api/devices/{imei} remains available for a known device even without issuance. An old seller listing is omitted after registration release.

post.description: Public references use primary or secondary IMEI only. Lifetime device history remains readable after registration release, transfer, or certificate revocation. Certificate UUIDs and short numbers are not accepted or returned. Revoke only the latest certificate belonging to the active registration. Access token required; historical state stays readable. Repeated revocation returns 204; no certificate in the current registration returns 404.

get.description: Returns 200 for any known IMEI including before certificate issuance, during sale with a released registration, after transfer, and after certificate revocation. Specs, latest measurements and counts span all registration periods. Missing observations and an unissued certificate are null. Measurements are observations, not proof of verification. Unknown devices return 404; owner identity, credentials and private attestation are never returned.

parameters.description: 15-digit IMEI with a valid check digit; primary and secondary IMEIs are accepted.
parameters.name: imei

get.description: Public status observations ordered by the IMEI-wide log sequence. Readable without authentication during release/transfer and after certificate revocation. Observations are not automatically verified; known devices without measurements return an empty page. Unknown IMEIs return 404.

parameters.description: 15-digit IMEI with a valid check digit; primary and secondary IMEIs are accepted.
parameters.name: imei

post.description: During sale or transfer, old credentials and keys lose writing authority while lifetime device state and history remain publicly readable by IMEI. The next holder can immediately register the same device and continue its sequence and previous hash.
